# Mehmet Haklıdır

> Founding Director, Artificial Intelligence Institute, TÜBİTAK BİLGEM, Türkiye. Researcher in agentic AI safety and governance (consent and accountability in multi-agent AI systems), deep reinforcement learning for autonomous systems, language technologies, and AI for health and geoscience. Contributor to national and international AI policy (Türkiye's National AI Strategy and Action Plan 2026–2030, OECD, GPAI, UNESCO).

Name spellings: Mehmet Haklıdır (Turkish) and Mehmet Haklidir (as printed in most English-language papers). Google Scholar, October 2026: 528 citations, h-index 11, i10-index 15.

Profiles: Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=sEOFMPoAAAAJ; ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4985-1116; Scopus: https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=25929922600; DBLP: https://dblp.org/pid/09/7320.html; ResearchGate: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Mehmet-Haklidir; LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mehmet-haklidir/; GitHub: https://github.com/haklidir; X: https://x.com/mhaklidir; Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mhaklidir/

## Concepts and frameworks

- [Accountability Graphs](https://haklidir.github.io/concepts/accountability-graphs/): A framework for attributing responsibility in conversational AI agent chains: agent chains are modelled as directed acyclic graphs with provenance metadata and causal responsibility semantics, and harm is traced backwards to graded responsibility scores.
- [AI for Geothermal Energy: Validation and Deployment Readiness](https://haklidir.github.io/concepts/ai-geothermal-readiness/): What a systematic evidence map of 626 peer-reviewed studies shows about AI in geothermal energy systems: how far methods have been validated beyond their development data, the E0–E4 evidence-readiness scale, and why transferability and deployment do not advance together.
- [Consent in Agentic AI](https://haklidir.github.io/concepts/consent-in-agentic-ai/): How user consent breaks down when AI systems act on people's behalf, interact with other agents and delegate to robots: the consent vacuum, consent chain degradation, the CoRVE runtime architecture and six consent vulnerabilities in agent ecosystems.
- [Guided Soft Actor-Critic (GSAC)](https://haklidir.github.io/concepts/guided-soft-actor-critic/): A deep reinforcement learning method for partially observable problems in which a guiding actor with privileged full-state access distils its policy into a control actor that acts on observation histories; extended in 2026 by Belief-Aware GSAC.

## Research areas

- [Agentic AI Safety & Governance](https://haklidir.github.io/research/agentic-ai-safety/): How consent, oversight and accountability hold up when AI systems act on people's behalf and interact with each other.
- [Reinforcement Learning & Autonomous Systems](https://haklidir.github.io/research/rl-autonomy/): Decision-making under uncertainty and partial observability for autonomous vehicles, robots and control.
- [AI for Geoscience & Energy](https://haklidir.github.io/research/geoscience-energy/): Machine learning and control for geothermal systems: reservoir temperature, contamination and scaling.
- [Language Technologies & LLMs](https://haklidir.github.io/research/language-tech/): Turkish language models, embedding benchmarks and multimodal language analysis.
- [AI for Health](https://haklidir.github.io/research/health-ai/): Privacy-preserving and trustworthy AI for clinical prediction, medical imaging and digital twins.
- [Computer Vision & Applied AI](https://haklidir.github.io/research/vision-applied/): Applied machine learning with industry and public partners, from livestock tracking to smart appliances.
- [Modeling, Simulation & Control](https://haklidir.github.io/research/modeling-simulation/): High-fidelity simulation, computer generated forces and control (2003–2015).
